caption:
Swipe and save. These 5 prompts turn your client emails, reviews, and raw numbers into case studies and testimonials that close deals for you. 📋

Prompt 1 turns a single client email into a 300-word case study using only their exact words, Prompt 2 turns a 5-star review into a full testimonial story ending with a direct quote, Prompt 3 writes the seven interview questions to send clients so they hand you the content themselves, Prompt 4 builds a case study from raw numbers and metrics alone with no client interview needed, Prompt 5 takes one finished case study and writes five versions at once: a LinkedIn post, a website headline, a proposal paragraph, a cold outreach line, and a pitch deck bullet.

Most businesses close deals through word of mouth, then lose that win forever. No case study, no testimonial, no proof on record. AI captures it in under a minute and turns it into five sales tools at once.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Anthropic, OpenAI
